Detailed Description

This class represents the time line. It schedules SoundEvent objects.

You should put every SoundEvent you have create in an object of this type, and use the tick () function of this class to call the other tick () functions. Beeing a SoundEvent itself, it can be scheduled in another object of the same type. NB: It DELETES the objects contained!

void Timeline::schedule ( SoundEvent *  event  ) 

Schedulation function.

To put a SoundEvent in the time line, just call this method. When the tick () method will be called, it will check the status flag of each SoundEvent and the activation time.

SoundFrame & Timeline::tick (  )  [virtual]

Sound production function.

It will call tick () function of every scheduled SoundEvent only if the status flag is set to true and if the activation time is coherent with the current time.
